questions.stem: A salary of Rs. 50000 decreases by 10%. Find the decrease amount only.
questions.explanation:
Only the reduced part is needed here.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=10\\%\text{ of }Rs. 50000$$

10% can also be written as the fraction 1/10.

$$10\\%=\frac{1}{10}$$

So find 10% of the original salary.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=50000\times\frac{10}{100}=5000$$

So the decrease amount is Rs. 5000.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=5000$$

questions.stem: A Warehouse A stock of 400 and a Warehouse B stock of 700 are reduced by 15% and 15% respectively. Find the difference between the resulting counts.
questions.explanation:
First find the new value of Warehouse A stock after its decrease.

$$\text{New Warehouse A stock}=400\times\frac{85}{100}=340$$

Now find the new value of Warehouse B stock after its decrease.

$$\text{New Warehouse B stock}=700\times\frac{85}{100}=595$$

Now compare the two new values.

$$\text{Difference}=\left|340-595\right|=255$$

So the difference between the new values is 255.

$$\text{Difference}=255$$

questions.stem: Express a 12.5% cut in the output as a multiplier.
questions.explanation:
A decrease of 12.5% leaves 87.5% of the original.

$$100\\%-12.5\\%=87.5\\%$$

87.5% can also be written as the fraction 7/8.

$$87.5\\%=\frac{7}{8}$$

Write this remaining percentage as a multiplier.

$$\text{Multiplier}=\frac{87.5}{100}=0.875$$

So the decrease multiplier is 0.875.

$$\text{Multiplier}=0.875$$

questions.stem: The current salary is Rs. 48000. Find the percentage decrease needed to make it Rs. 36000.
questions.explanation:
First find how much reduction is needed to reach the target.

$$\text{Needed reduction}=48000-36000=12000$$

Now compare this reduction with the current salary.

$$\text{Required decrease}=\frac{12000}{48000}\times100=25\\%$$

So the required percentage decrease is 25%.

$$\text{Required decrease}=25\\%$$

questions.stem: An income records percentage decreases of 20% and 10% one after another. Find the combined percentage decrease.
questions.explanation:
Convert both decreases into retained factors.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{90}{100}$$

This combined factor shows what fraction of the original still remains.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{90}{100}=0.72$$

So subtract the remaining fraction from 1 and convert it into percent.

$$\text{Net decrease}=28\\%$$

So the overall percentage decrease is 28%.

$$\text{Net decrease}=28\\%$$

questions.stem: A company has 200 employees. 50% are trained employees, and the rest are untrained employees. The two groups decrease by 15% and 15%. Find the new share of trained employees.
questions.explanation:
At first, 50% of the employees are trained employees. So split the original total.

$$\text{Initial trained employees}=200\times\frac{50}{100}=100,\ \text{Initial untrained employees}=100$$

Now decrease the numbers of trained employees and untrained employees by their respective percentages.

$$\text{New trained employees}=100\times\frac{85}{100}=85,\ \text{New untrained employees}=100\times\frac{85}{100}=85$$

Use the new total to find the updated percentage of trained employees.

$$\text{New trained employees percent}=\frac{85}{170}\times100=50\\%$$

So the new percentage of trained employees is 50%.

$$\text{New trained employees percent}=50\\%$$

questions.stem: A expenditure is Rs. 20000 at present and decreases by 10% every year. Find the expenditure after 3 years.
questions.explanation:
Each decrease of 10% leaves 90% of the expenditure.

$$100\\%-10\\%=90\\%$$

90% can also be written as the fraction 9/10.

$$90\\%=\frac{9}{10}$$

Since the same decrease happens for 3 periods, use the retained factor 3 times.

$$\text{Overall factor}=\left(\frac{90}{100}\right)^{3}$$

Now multiply the current expenditure by this overall factor.

$$\text{Final expenditure}=20000\times\left(\frac{90}{100}\right)^{3}=14580$$

So the expenditure after 3 periods is Rs. 14580.

$$\text{Final expenditure}=14580$$

questions.stem: The final number of employees is 18000 after a 10% decrease. What was the original number?
questions.explanation:
After a decrease of 10%, the new value becomes 90% of the original.

$$90\\%\rightarrow18000$$

90% can also be written as the fraction 9/10.

$$90\\%=\frac{9}{10}$$

First find the value of 1% by dividing 18000 by 90.

$$1\\%=\frac{18000}{90}=200$$

Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the original value.

$$100\\%=200\times100=20000$$

So the original employees were 20000.

$$\text{Original employees}=20000$$

questions.stem: The town had 5000 residents. It decreased by 20% and then by 25%. Find the final number of residents.
questions.explanation:
After the first decrease of 20%, the residents become 80% of its original value.

$$\text{After first decrease}=5000\times\frac{80}{100}=4000$$

Now decrease this new value by 25%.

$$\text{Final value}=4000\times\frac{75}{100}=3000$$

So the residents after both decreases are 3000.

$$\text{Final residents}=3000$$

questions.stem: An asset has an asset value of Rs. 60000. If it depreciates by 15%, find the new asset value.
questions.explanation:
Decrease = 15%. So the remaining value is 85% of the original.

$$100\\%-15\\%=85\\%$$

Now take 85% of the original asset value.

$$\text{New asset value}=60000\times\frac{85}{100}=51000$$

So the new asset value is Rs. 51000.

$$\text{New asset value}=51000$$

questions.stem: An amount of Rs. 40000 is recorded as the bonus fund. After a fall of 12%, find the reduction only.
questions.explanation:
Only the reduced part is needed here.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=12\\%\text{ of }Rs. 40000$$

So find 12% of the original bonus fund.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=40000\times\frac{12}{100}=4800$$

So the decrease amount is Rs. 4800.

$$\text{Decrease amount}=4800$$

questions.stem: The Fund A value is Rs. 50000, while the Fund B value is Rs. 25000. After percentage decreases of 15% and 10%, find the difference between the two updated values.
questions.explanation:
First find the new value of Fund A value after its decrease.

$$\text{New Fund A value}=50000\times\frac{85}{100}=42500$$

Now find the new value of Fund B value after its decrease.

$$\text{New Fund B value}=25000\times\frac{90}{100}=22500$$

Now compare the two new values.

$$\text{Difference}=\left|42500-22500\right|=20000$$

So the difference between the new values is Rs. 20000.

$$\text{Difference}=20000$$

questions.stem: If the marked price is cut by 20%, find the single multiplier for the revised value.
questions.explanation:
A decrease of 20% leaves 80% of the original.

$$100\\%-20\\%=80\\%$$

80% can also be written as the fraction 4/5.

$$80\\%=\frac{4}{5}$$

Write this remaining percentage as a multiplier.

$$\text{Multiplier}=\frac{80}{100}=0.8$$

So the decrease multiplier is 0.8.

$$\text{Multiplier}=0.8$$

questions.stem: The present number of voters is 600. Find the percentage decrease needed to reduce it to 450.
questions.explanation:
First find how much reduction is needed to reach the target.

$$\text{Needed reduction}=600-450=150$$

Now compare this reduction with the current voters.

$$\text{Required decrease}=\frac{150}{600}\times100=25\\%$$

So the required percentage decrease is 25%.

$$\text{Required decrease}=25\\%$$

questions.stem: For a turnover, the first decrease is 20% and the second is 25%. Find the net decrease percentage.
questions.explanation:
Convert both decreases into retained factors.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{75}{100}$$

This combined factor shows what fraction of the original still remains.

$$\text{Combined factor}=\frac{80}{100}\times\frac{75}{100}=0.6$$

So subtract the remaining fraction from 1 and convert it into percent.

$$\text{Net decrease}=40\\%$$

So the overall percentage decrease is 40%.

$$\text{Net decrease}=40\\%$$

questions.stem: In a total of 300 workers, 60% are male workers. The rest are female workers. After the numbers of male workers and female workers fall by 15% and 10% respectively, find the percentage of male workers in the new total.
questions.explanation:
At first, 60% of the workers are male workers. So split the original total.

$$\text{Initial male workers}=300\times\frac{60}{100}=180,\ \text{Initial female workers}=120$$

Now decrease the numbers of male workers and female workers by their respective percentages.

$$\text{New male workers}=180\times\frac{85}{100}=153,\ \text{New female workers}=120\times\frac{90}{100}=108$$

Use the new total to find the updated percentage of male workers.

$$\text{New male workers percent}=\frac{153}{261}\times100=58.6207\\%$$

So the new percentage of male workers is 58.6207%.

$$\text{New male workers percent}=58.6207\\%$$

questions.stem: A business has Rs. 30000 as its annual turnover. If this decreases by 15% per year, find the value after 3 years.
questions.explanation:
Each decrease of 15% leaves 85% of the annual turnover.

$$100\\%-15\\%=85\\%$$

Since the same decrease happens for 3 periods, use the retained factor 3 times.

$$\text{Overall factor}=\left(\frac{85}{100}\right)^{3}$$

Now multiply the current annual turnover by this overall factor.

$$\text{Final annual turnover}=30000\times\left(\frac{85}{100}\right)^{3}=18423.75$$

So the annual turnover after 3 periods is Rs. 18423.75.

$$\text{Final annual turnover}=18423.75$$

questions.stem: After a 25% decrease, the population became 18000. Find the original population.
questions.explanation:
After a decrease of 25%, the new value becomes 75% of the original.

$$75\\%\rightarrow18000$$

75% can also be written as the fraction 3/4.

$$75\\%=\frac{3}{4}$$

First find the value of 1% by dividing 18000 by 75.

$$1\\%=\frac{18000}{75}=240$$

Now multiply the value of 1% by 100 to get the original value.

$$100\\%=240\times100=24000$$

So the original population was 24000.

$$\text{Original population}=24000$$

questions.stem: A factory produced 8000 units. Output fell by 15% and later by 10%. Find the final output.
questions.explanation:
After the first decrease of 15%, the units become 85% of its original value.

$$\text{After first decrease}=8000\times\frac{85}{100}=6800$$

Now decrease this new value by 10%.

$$\text{Final value}=6800\times\frac{90}{100}=6120$$

So the units after both decreases are 6120.

$$\text{Final units}=6120$$

questions.stem: The monthly salary was Rs. 60000. It decreased by 12%. Find the revised monthly salary.
questions.explanation:
Decrease = 12%. So the remaining value is 88% of the original.

$$100\\%-12\\%=88\\%$$

Now take 88% of the original monthly salary.

$$\text{New monthly salary}=60000\times\frac{88}{100}=52800$$

So the new monthly salary is Rs. 52800.

$$\text{New monthly salary}=52800$$
